title: Yatharth Nishpaksh Samajh — Training Centre
purpose: A voluntary learning programme for evidence literacy, impartial process, humane communication, conflict-of-interest awareness, privacy, and accountable community protection.

governance.trainer_role: Facilitator and mentor only; a trainer has no judicial, policing, medical, legal-representation, funding, or adjudication authority by virtue of this programme or any Yatharth Mudra honour.
governance.selection: Open, accessible and non-discriminatory; selection must not depend on wealth, token ownership, caste, religion, gender, disability, political affiliation or ability to pay.
governance.independent_oversight: Use qualified external educators and safeguarding/privacy reviewers where relevant; disclose conflicts and preserve complaints and appeals.
governance.no_guarantee: Completion does not prove a person is perfectly impartial, fit for public office, or legally qualified.

curriculum.name: Evidence literacy
curriculum.assessment: Analyze a fictional case and cite supporting and contradicting evidence.

curriculum.name: Impartial reasoning
curriculum.assessment: Blind review of balanced case scenarios with written rationale.

curriculum.name: Rights, law and due process
curriculum.assessment: Identify when a matter must be referred to qualified professionals or lawful authorities.

curriculum.name: Conflicts, ethics and accountability
curriculum.assessment: Complete a conflict disclosure and recusal simulation.

curriculum.name: Privacy and safeguarding
curriculum.assessment: Prepare a privacy-safe evidence record from a fictional scenario.

curriculum.name: Community and ecological protection
topics: food, clothing, education, healthcare and housing needs
curriculum.assessment: Create a proportionate project plan with measurable outcomes and safeguards.

relationship_to_existing_policy.rule: This training file references the existing seven-level policy rather than copying or modifying its criteria. Philosophical concepts such as the creator-defined heart/mind ratio remain personal framing, not validated psychological measurements.

learning_path.continuity: Offer repeat learning and refresher opportunities. Do not require fasting, deprivation, isolation, unpaid labour, public disclosure, or uninterrupted 365-day participation.
learning_path.accessibility: Provide reasonable accommodations, language access and a non-digital participation route where feasible.
learning_path.assessment: Use published rubrics, multiple assessors where practical, recorded feedback, appeal and correction. A score is a learning indicator, not a moral rank or legal credential.

cohort_model.expansion_gate: Expand only after the pilot has documented learner consent, completion, independent evaluation, safeguarding performance, complaints handling and available resources.
cohort_model.trainer_to_learner_ratio: Set and publish before each cohort based on safeguarding and supervision capacity; do not invent a universal ratio.

pilot_activation_gates: Named accountable operator and documented resources
Curriculum reviewed by qualified educators and relevant safeguarding experts
Privacy notice, consent process, retention schedule and secure storage
Accessible complaint, appeal and incident-response routes
Assessment rubric and independent evaluation plan
Pilot results reviewed before any scale-up claim
success_definition: Demonstrated learning, safer practice, fairer documented processes and verified project outcomes—not number of certificates, currency claims, judicial appointments or unsupported claims about national or global capacity.
legal_boundary: Voluntary educational framework only. It creates no judicial authority, legal qualification, professional licence, public office, financial instrument, guaranteed funding or entitlement.
